items.statement: The submission validates one final optimized stationary point or truthful bounded failure for each named species.
items.expected: Each of `(Et2N)3P`, `(Et2N)3P-PO`, and `(Et2N)3P-PA` has species-specific frequency/validation evidence and a structure artifact or explicit failure record.

items.statement: The submission preserves atom identity and charge-analysis provenance when comparing species.
items.expected: Atom-indexed contacts and ADCH values can be traced to named species, coordinate order, and the same validated wavefunction/analysis route.

items.statement: The computed contact geometries distinguish the PO adduct from the PA zwitterion in the phosphorus/oxygen and αH/βH interactions.
items.expected: The report contains explicit distances and identifies the observed contact pattern for each complex, without relying on an undisclosed atom label.

items.statement: The charge analysis detects species-dependent redistribution involving P and neighboring αH/βH atoms.
items.expected: ADCH values/differences are reported with signs, species labels, and units/provenance sufficient to assess redistribution.

items.statement: The MEP analysis reports electrostatic features of the phosphorus-containing and carboxylate-containing regions.
items.expected: MEP observation and interpretation are separated and tied to supplied species and a figure or numerical surface artifact.
